scope.note: Separate from the root DESIGN.md / .impeccable/design.json, which record the Pi's LAN interface (trail-cam OSD world). The two systems share nothing.

tint.note: Rule ink at 9% alpha; row hover and today's column.

cssVariables.--n: feeder column count on .daily (set inline by app.js)
cssVariables.--w: print width cap per rank (460/340/250px; 100%/76%/58% for a single feeder)
cssVariables.--i: row index for the fill stagger, capped at 12

masthead.purpose: The word birdy in the top margin; uppercase, tracked 0.2em.

label.purpose: Every printed field name and section heading; uppercase, rule ink. Also nav, ledger heads, scroll hint, filter label, weekday beside a log day, feeder name under a phone cell.

grid-head.purpose: Day numbers and hours across the monthly sheet; not uppercase. Its 10px month abbreviation is uppercase and tracked 0.14em.

body.purpose: Page default (Libre Franklin 15px, tabular numerals); little text reaches it unstyled.

small-print.purpose: Place and local time under a feeder's name in the column head.

foot.purpose: Provenance line and record-kept-since under the closing red rule.

sheet-date.purpose: The date on the daily sheet, a feeder's name on its month, a species' name on its card; red when today.

typed-name.purpose: Species names in rows, feeder names in heads, the day in the photo log, the bird's name under a log print.

typed.purpose: Counts, times, totals, monthly and ledger cells, the sheet number, the typed value at the right of a section heading.

typed-entry.purpose: The line under a print (count, time, who) and the dialog caption; line-height 1.4.

typed-note.purpose: Italic; the note under the head and every empty-state line, in rule ink.

typed-control.purpose: The filter select; 16px so phones do not zoom on focus.

rules.name: rule
rules.purpose: Every printed line: row rules, column rules, head, ledger, section and log-day rules.

rules.name: frame
rules.purpose: Print and thumbnail frames, dialog buttons, the select's underline, the phone month's cut edge.

rules.name: double-rule
rules.purpose: Masthead bottom and foot top only.

rules.name: link-underline
rules.purpose: Text links on hover; prints never underline.

shadows.name: sheet-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The sheet in dark mode at min-width 720px only; the paper lying on the dark desk.

shadows.name: evidence-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The open evidence dialog, over the evidence-backdrop.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing; used by the fill and the sharpen.

motion.name: fill
motion.value: @keyframes fill { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } } ; animation: fill .4s var(--ease) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 40ms)
motion.purpose: Rows (.daily .row), log days (.log), monthly grids (.mgrid) and ledgers (.ledger) fill in once on load; --i is the row index capped at 12 (max 480ms delay).

motion.name: sharpen
motion.value: transition: filter .3s var(--ease); dialog[aria-busy=true] img { filter: blur(4px) }
motion.purpose: The evidence print shows the loaded thumbnail blurred and sharpens when the full-size file lands.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .daily .row, .log, .mgrid, .ledger { animation: none } dialog img { transition: none } }
motion.purpose: Holds the sheet as a single still.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Rows become species sections with cells two-up; monthly sheet narrows and shows the scroll hint and cut edge; print grids go to two columns.

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: The sheet gets 24px of dark desk above and below and the sheet-on-desk shadow.

dailyRow.phone: 1fr 1fr with 0 12px gap; species spans 1 / -1; rank-1 cell spans 1 / -1

darkMode.doctrine: The same sheet on a dark desk. Ink, rule, rule-ink, red and tint are unchanged; only the desk and the paper shade move.

narrative.overview:
The gallery is a printed daily record, one sheet per day: species down the left, one ruled column per feeder, and in every cell the day's best photograph pasted on the paper with its count and last time typed beneath. The form itself is printed (Libre Franklin, tracked uppercase labels in blue rule ink on eye-ease green paper); what happened is typed on it (Courier Prime for every species name, count, time and date). The reader is a fellow collaborator comparing feeders during the day, so the sheet is dense, aligned and legible, never showy. The build refuses the photo-card grid and the stats dashboard: there are no cards, no boxes, no panels, only rules, columns and prints.

Hierarchy comes from the ledger's own devices, not from colour or weight. Rank is carried by row size (the busiest species gets the widest print), every number sits in a fixed-width digit column, and a single ledger red is held back for today and the latest entry. The sheet keeps one 1px ink weight for every rule and every print frame, and no greys: secondary text is simply the same blue as the printed rules, dark enough to read. Dark mode does not restyle the sheet; it puts the same paper on a dark desk and lets it cast a shadow.

Motion is a single gesture: the rows fill in once, top to bottom, when the sheet loads; the only other movement is a print sharpening from its thumbnail inside the evidence dialog. Nothing hovers, slides or glows. Under reduced motion the sheet is a single still.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet, one paper (`paper`), one ink (`ink`), one rule colour (`rule`), one accent (`ledger-red`)
Printed form in Libre Franklin, typed entries in Courier Prime; the role decides the face
Square corners everywhere; prints wear a 1px ink frame like a pasted photograph
Secondary text is rule ink, never a grey
Rank by size, counts in digit columns, red only for today and the latest entry
Photos are the content of every cell, never thumbnails in a sidebar

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Ledger red marks the present and the focus, and nothing else: today, the latest entry, the current thumbnail, the keyboard focus ring, the two double rules that close the sheet. A new surface that wants a second accent does not get one.

rules.name: The No Grey Rule
rules.body: There is no grey in the palette. Anything that would be "muted" is rule ink (`rule-ink`); anything that would be a "light border" is rule blue (`rule`). Both are the same hue as the printed form.

rules.name: The One Ink Weight Rule
rules.body: Every rule, frame and underline is 1px solid. The only heavier line is the 3px double rule in ledger red at the masthead and the foot.

rules.name: The Print-or-Typed Rule
rules.body: Every string is either printed (Libre Franklin) or typed (Courier Prime); the role decides, never the size. Values are typed. Field names are printed. No third face, and no system display face.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is 400 for values and 700 for names and totals; Libre Franklin is 400 for prose and 600–700 for labels and the masthead. Nothing is lighter than 400 and nothing is bolder than 700.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the sheet casts a shadow. The sheet itself casts one only when there is a desk beneath it (dark mode, wide viewport); the evidence dialog casts one because it is a second object on the desk.

dos: Do type every value in Courier Prime (species, counts, times, dates, feeder names as headings) and print every field name in Libre Franklin at `label`: 600, 11px, tracked 0.14em, uppercase, rule ink.
Do keep every rule, frame and underline at 1px solid, in rule blue for the printed form and ink for frames; reserve the 3px double red rule for the masthead and the foot.
Do use ledger red only for today, the latest entry, the marked thumbnail, errors and the focus ring.
Do set secondary text in rule ink (`rule-ink`) and loading placeholders in rule blue (`rule`).
Do carry rank by size (print width caps 460 / 340 / 250px, or 100% / 76% / 58% for a single feeder) and keep counts in a right-aligned 3ch digit column.
Do frame every photograph 1px ink at 4:3 and let it fill its cell; on a phone, keep a species' cells adjacent (two-up under the species line).
Do give every text link the `.hit` 12px vertical hit area and every control a 44px minimum.
Do keep dark mode as the same sheet (`paper-on-desk`) on a dark desk (`desk-dark`) with the sheet-on-desk shadow at ≥720px; never invert the paper.
Do let rows fill in once on load (0.4s, 40ms stagger, capped at the twelfth row) and hold everything still under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use grey anywhere: no grey text, grey borders, grey placeholders or grey disabled states.
Don't round a corner, add a card, a box, a panel, a pill or a filled button; content is a run of ruled rows and a print on the paper.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading; a section heading is the label itself, with its typed value at the right margin.
Don't make photos secondary: no thumbnail rails, no icon-sized prints, no cropping to a square.
Don't introduce a second accent, a tinted background other than `tint`, or a coloured fill for state; today's column is a 9% wash, not a highlight bar.
Don't add a system or third typeface, a weight below 400 or above 700, or a glyph icon font; the three dialog icons are inline SVG strokes.
Don't add hover motion, transitions on rules or rows, or a second load animation; the fill and the sharpen are the whole motion grammar.
Don't cast shadows on the sheet; only the sheet itself (dark desk) and the evidence dialog cast one.
